info.title: Micelio site API
info.description: The HTTP routes every Micelio site serves: 32 paths and 34 operations, from `server/api` and `server/routes`. Generated from `server/openapi/` and the zod schemas of `server/schemas/`; do not edit by hand. Errors under `/api` are problem details (RFC 9457). Response bodies are described by status and media type, naming their TypeScript type in `app/interfaces`; no route has a response schema yet.

servers.description: Your site. The API is served from the same origin as the pages.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Sign-in, registration, passwords and the profile. Needs the accounts module.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: Guest comments on articles. Needs the comments module.

tags.name: Content
tags.description: The blog content, the CMS pages and the site identity.

tags.name: Drafts
tags.description: Unpublished articles, for editors only. Needs the drafts module.

tags.name: Fediverse
tags.description: Reactions from the fediverse. Needs the fediverse module.

tags.name: Newsletter
tags.description: Subscription by email. Needs the newsletter module.

tags.name: Site files
tags.description: RSS feeds, the sitemap and robots.txt, served outside `/api`.

parameters.description: A known category slug, trimmed and lowercased.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The language of the content: `en` or `es`. An unknown value is a 400; an empty one counts as absent.

200.description: The reading path. Body: `ReadingPath` (`app/interfaces`). Cache-Control: `public, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=600`.

400.description:
Bad Request. The `code` is one of:
- `invalidRequest`: The request is malformed or a parameter is invalid.

502.description:
Bad Gateway. The `code` is one of:
- `upstreamUnavailable`: The content service failed or is unreachable.

default.description: Any other error, usually a 500 `internalError` or a 405 `methodNotAllowed`.

get.summary: Search articles
get.description: At most ten results. A text under three characters answers an empty list, and so does a CMS failure.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search text, at most 200 characters.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The language of the content: `en` or `es`. An unknown value is a 400; an empty one counts as absent.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: `1` or `true` searches the article body too.

200.description: The matching articles. Body: `SearchPostResult[]` (`app/interfaces`). Cache-Control: `public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=120`.

400.description:
Bad Request. The `code` is one of:
- `invalidRequest`: The request is malformed or a parameter is invalid.

404.description:
Not Found. The `code` is one of:
- `notFound`: The resource does not exist.

default.description: Any other error, usually a 500 `internalError` or a 405 `methodNotAllowed`.

get.summary: Get the site identity and its modules
